meta.title: Optimize theme application performance for deeply nested components
meta.body_summary: Optimize theme application in figma-plugin by skipping deep recursive traversal of subtrees that lack relevant style IDs, addressing 30-60 minute freezes on deeply nested components.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added early-exit checks and tests for recursive theme application; zero maintainer engagement, PR closed after ~13 months of inactivity without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 340 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, focused on a single plugin module and its tests. It fits a moderate performance PR that was closed without merge due to prolonged inactivity and lack of review.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review or CHANGES_REQUESTED feedback present in the dataset; only an automated changeset-bot comment about missing changeset.
review_details.performance_claim: Optimizes theme application by pruning recursion for subtrees without relevant style IDs, potentially orders-of-magnitude improvement for deeply nested components that previously froze Figma for 30-60 minutes.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after ~13 months of inactivity with no maintainer interaction; no explicit rejection text.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Plugin-level performance refactor with no maintainer feedback; closed after extended inactivity, indicating a process gap for this contributor/agent PR.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body describes the performance problem (30-60 minute freeze) and claims improvement but provides no benchmark numbers, profiling data, or reproducible before/after metrics.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fixes or further iterations occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Added hasRelevantStyleId and nodeHasRelevantStyles helpers in applySiblingStyle.ts to check if a node's subtree contains relevant style IDs before recursing, and modified applySiblingStyleId to skip processing children when no relevant styles are present. Added unit tests for the optimization logic.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: StartScreen.tsx change was a minor 4-line modification in an analysis/plan commit, unrelated to the core optimization.
